title: MedSim
tagline: Practice clinical consults by voice in a 3D Indian hospital.
description: MedSim is a voice-first clinical training simulator for Indian medical students. Learners walk through a 3D hospital, talk to AI patients in seven Indian languages, speak orders that Nurse Asha carries out with tool calls such as drug-interaction checks, and receive a graded debrief. It uses Agora Conversational AI with Sarvam and Murf, React Three Fiber and a FastAPI backend. It is a training simulator, not medical advice, and its cases are synthetic.
author: Darshan Krishna N

media.thumbnailAlt: MedSim title card from the project trailer: a red medical cross with a pulse line above the words MedSim and Talk. Order. Get graded.
media.demoNote: Microphone recommended; typing also works. The free-tier host sleeps when idle, so the first load can take about 50 seconds.
